high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Bloomberg Businessweek, displayed on Instagram. The article discusses the routine of Bernard Arnault, the chairman and chief executive officer of LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE. The text is written in English and mentions that every Saturday morning, Arnault spends a few hours visiting his temples dedicated to luxury brands such as handbags, couture, jewelry, and exorbitantly priced watches. The article highlights Arnault's meticulous attention to detail and his role in overseeing the opulence of these luxury brands.
